title: PersonPropertiesAtTimeMetadata
description: Serializer for the point-in-time query metadata.

queried_timestamp.description: The timestamp that was queried in ISO format

distinct_id_used.description: The distinct_id parameter used in the request

person_id_used.description: The person_id parameter used in the request

query_mode.description: Whether the query used 'distinct_id' or 'person_id' mode

distinct_ids_queried.description: All distinct_ids that were queried for this person

distinct_ids_count.description: Number of distinct_ids associated with this person
